notes: Text-free hero, so it carries both the Spanish (2 PM) and English (4 PM) posts. One person at a small lit desk dwarfed by a grid of dark cabinets filling the frame. Approved on the second roll. Roll 1 (hero-01.jpg) asked for two corridors of different lengths lit by one fixture; it returned two ceiling lights and two unrelated corridors, so the "light reaches only partway" beat was lost and it read as a generic datacenter. Rejected for concept, not craft. The approved roll carries the boldest red in the set (a rectangle bounding the lit alcove) and is the only hero with a human figure, which suits a post about headcount.
